question: Should experimental Claw packages adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical emitted manifest while retaining JSON as a readable compatibility format?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the format works, but choosing the canonical authored and exported package representation creates a durable user and tooling contract that implementation review cannot approve.

options.title: Adopt after RFC approval
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as canonical in the RFC, retain JSON reads, and land this branch after its stacked dependency.

options.title: Accept input only
options.body: Allow packages to reference `CLAW.md` but continue exporting JSON until the canonical package format is decided.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the draft branch open without landing until the RFC and full Claws lifecycle contract are accepted.

recommendation.title: Adopt after RFC approval
recommendation.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as canonical in the RFC, retain JSON reads, and land this branch after its stacked dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and the strongest visible owner of the agent-centric product and schema boundaries governing this format decision.
